# Signatories

## Project team

I am Johan Larsson, Arity's maintainer and a postdoctoral researcher in
statistics and machine learning at the University of Copenhagen's Department of
Mathematical Sciences. I also develop and maintain several R packages, including
[eulerr](https://github.com/jolars/eulerr),
[SLOPE](https://github.com/jolars/SLOPE), and
[qualpalr](https://github.com/jolars/qualpalr).

## Contributors

I will carry out the work myself. The budget does not include development time
from other contributors.

## Consulted

I'm grateful for feedback from Tatsuya Shima (maintainer of
[arf](https://github.com/eitsupi/arf),
[rd2qmd](https://github.com/eitsupi/rd2qmd),
[r-documentation-rs](https://github.com/eitsupi/r-documentation-rs), and
[mini-roxygen](https://github.com/eitsupi/mini-roxygen)), whose suggestions
helped clarify and improve the proposal.
